title: THE FLAG GAME?
cues: Rain on mud. The tract lies face-down, back page up. LOOP FRAME: identical to the film's last frame.
A gust flips the tract face-up: the cover THE FLAG GAME?
Pages riffle open in the wind.
Camera dives into page 1, panel 1: the comic comes alive.
'YELLOW FLAGS': the flag-bearer (the Preacher) passes behind them.
The Chick-tract witness is suddenly right there.
The Preacher becomes a Byzantine icon raising the Flag.
The ** footnote types on at legal speed.
Summer's face snaps into anime style (sparkles, sweat drop).
'Alchemy': wavy flashback ripple into the past; engraving style begins.
Six plain yellow Flags on the op-art hexagon field.
Stink lines rise off the hippies.
The stench coalesces into a hurricane.
The Flag Maker walks amongst them (candlesticks, rain).
His words start turning into FLAGS FLAGS FLAGS; the chant rises.
'every': the FLAGS text flood fills the frame.
White card: BUT THERE WERE SOME THAT LISTENED...
A muddy hippie pulls a Flag from the mud.
The Seraphlag sets the Flag atop the effigy.
'Entirely': the drops fall away; the firmament dome, propped up by the Flag, is revealed.
'FLAG': flames reach the top; the Flag lifts free and ascends like an ember.
'OPENED': cracks race across the sky dome.
'RETURNED': the waters above the firmament pour down.
The Spirit of the Flags walks on.
The walker lowers his mask: it is the Preacher. Back to the present.
The camp, in the rain, now.
Altar-call hymn begins under the prayer.
Summer's 'Amen.': the rain stops; a sunbeam.
Into the tract: the Print Gallery spiral.
The spiral resolves into the camp, the next day.
'YELLOW FLAGS': it is Summer carrying the flag now.
It lands face-down in the mud, back page up.
End = the loop frame (identical to film_start).

chant.desc: The crowd's incomprehension: all they hear is FLAGS FLAGS FLAGS. Rising crowd chant; the Devil's V02 lands on it.

hymn.title: Just As I Am (without one Flag)
lyrics: Just as I am, without one Flag,
But that Thy yellow waves for me,
And that Thou bidd'st me move to Thee,
O Flag of Flags, I come, I come.
hymn.desc: Soft altar-call choir + organ under the lorem-ipsum prayer; plagal 'A-men' lands on Summer's Amen.
